title: The 1917 Chicago contract and band personnel
summary: Looking at the April 1917 contract, Duhé names the band members, the pay, the New Orleans Jazz Band name and the bookers.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
